services.name: Amazon EC2
services.oneLinePurpose: Resizable virtual machines in the cloud.
examPitfalls: The customer patches and manages the OS (shared responsibility)
Instance categories matter: compute-optimized vs storage-optimized

services.name: AWS Lambda
services.oneLinePurpose: Run code without managing servers, paying per invocation.
examPitfalls: Serverless ≠ no servers: AWS manages them
Not suited for very long or continuously busy jobs

services.name: AWS Fargate
services.oneLinePurpose: Serverless compute engine for containers (ECS/EKS).
examPitfalls: Fargate is not an orchestrator: it is the execution engine

services.name: Amazon ECS
services.oneLinePurpose: AWS's own container orchestration.
examPitfalls: ECS = AWS's own orchestration; EKS = Kubernetes

services.name: Amazon EKS
services.oneLinePurpose: Managed Kubernetes on AWS.
examPitfalls: Exam keyword: "Kubernetes" → EKS

services.name: AWS Auto Scaling
services.oneLinePurpose: Automatically adjust capacity to demand.
examPitfalls: Auto Scaling = elasticity; a load balancer distributes traffic

services.name: Amazon S3
services.oneLinePurpose: Object storage with very high durability and classes by access pattern.
examPitfalls: Object ≠ block ≠ file
Pick the class by access frequency and retrieval urgency

services.name: Amazon S3 Glacier
services.oneLinePurpose: Low-cost archiving with retrievals from minutes to hours.
examPitfalls: Not for frequent access; retrieval times vary by class

services.name: Amazon EBS
services.oneLinePurpose: Persistent block volumes for EC2 instances.
examPitfalls: Persistent (survives stops) vs instance store (ephemeral)

services.name: Amazon EFS
services.oneLinePurpose: Elastic shared file system (NFS) for Linux instances.
examPitfalls: Shared file ≠ object (S3) ≠ block (EBS)

services.name: Amazon FSx
services.oneLinePurpose: Managed third-party file systems (Windows File Server, Lustre, etc.).
examPitfalls: FSx = specific file systems; EFS = elastic NFS for Linux

services.name: AWS Storage Gateway
services.oneLinePurpose: Connects on-premises environments with cloud storage (hybrid/cache).
keyUseCases: Extend local storage to S3 with caching
examPitfalls: Hybrid scenario: frequent local access, backup/archive in the cloud

services.name: AWS Backup
services.oneLinePurpose: Centralized, automated backup across AWS services.
examPitfalls: Centralizes backups of several services; it does not replace S3 classes

services.name: Amazon RDS
services.oneLinePurpose: Managed relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.).
keyUseCases: Relational databases without managing OS or patching
examPitfalls: Managed service: AWS operates the OS and the database, not the customer

services.name: Amazon Aurora
services.oneLinePurpose: Managed relational database compatible with MySQL/PostgreSQL with better performance.
examPitfalls: Aurora is AWS's own engine, not plain MySQL

services.name: Amazon DynamoDB
services.oneLinePurpose: Serverless NoSQL key-value database with low latency at any scale.
examPitfalls: NoSQL ≠ relational: no joins or traditional SQL

services.name: Amazon ElastiCache
services.oneLinePurpose: In-memory cache (Redis/Memcached) to reduce latency.
examPitfalls: Cache ≠ durable storage

services.name: AWS Database Migration Service (DMS)
services.oneLinePurpose: Migrates data between databases, with live replication.
keyUseCases: Migrating on-premises databases to AWS with minimal downtime
examPitfalls: DMS moves data; SCT converts schemas

services.name: AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT)
services.oneLinePurpose: Converts schemas and code between different database engines.
examPitfalls: Converts the schema; it does not replicate data

services.name: Amazon VPC
services.oneLinePurpose: Isolated private virtual network in AWS with subnets and gateways.
examPitfalls: Security group (stateful, instance) vs network ACL (stateless, subnet)

services.name: Amazon Route 53
services.oneLinePurpose: Managed DNS, domain registration, and health checks.
examPitfalls: Not just domain registration: managed DNS with routing

services.name: Amazon CloudFront
services.oneLinePurpose: Content delivery network (CDN) that caches at edge locations.
examPitfalls: Edge locations cache content; they do not host applications

services.name: AWS Direct Connect
services.oneLinePurpose: Dedicated private connection between premises and AWS.
examPitfalls: Dedicated/private vs Site-to-Site VPN (encrypted over the internet, quick to create)

services.name: AWS VPN (Site-to-Site / Client)
services.oneLinePurpose: Encrypted connectivity to AWS over the internet.
keyUseCases: Quickly connecting a local network or remote users
examPitfalls: VPN = quick to set up over the internet; Direct Connect = dedicated line

services.name: AWS IAM
services.oneLinePurpose: Management of users, groups, roles, and permission policies.
examPitfalls: Authentication ≠ authorization
Roles = temporary credentials; preferable to access keys

services.name: AWS IAM Identity Center
services.oneLinePurpose: Centralized access management for organizations and identity federation.
examPitfalls: Centralizes human access; it does not replace IAM for services

services.name: AWS KMS
services.oneLinePurpose: Create and administer encryption keys.
examPitfalls: Encrypts with keys; key management is the core concept

services.name: AWS Secrets Manager
services.oneLinePurpose: Store and rotate secrets (credentials, API keys).
examPitfalls: Secrets ≠ encryption keys (KMS)

services.name: AWS Artifact
services.oneLinePurpose: Portal to download AWS compliance documents (ISO, PCI, SOC).
examPitfalls: It is documentation, not security configuration

services.name: Amazon GuardDuty
services.oneLinePurpose: Intelligent threat detection through continuous analysis.
keyUseCases: Detecting anomalous behavior and suspicious access
examPitfalls: Detects threats; Inspector assesses vulnerabilities

services.name: Amazon Inspector
services.oneLinePurpose: Automated vulnerability management for workloads.
keyUseCases: Scanning software vulnerabilities and network exposures
examPitfalls: Vulnerabilities ≠ active threats (GuardDuty)

services.name: AWS Security Hub
services.oneLinePurpose: Centralized view of security posture and aggregated alerts.
keyUseCases: Single security panel across services and accounts
examPitfalls: Aggregates and prioritizes; it does not replace the tools that detect

services.name: AWS Shield
services.oneLinePurpose: Protection against denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks.
examPitfalls: DDoS ≠ application exploits (that is WAF)

services.name: AWS WAF
services.oneLinePurpose: Web application firewall against common HTTP exploits.
examPitfalls: Layer 7 / HTTP; Shield is network DDoS

services.name: AWS Firewall Manager
services.oneLinePurpose: Centralized management of WAF/firewall rules across organization accounts.
examPitfalls: Manages at organization level; WAF applies the rules

services.name: AWS CloudTrail
services.oneLinePurpose: Audit log of API calls and actions in the account.
examPitfalls: API auditing ≠ metrics (CloudWatch) ≠ configuration (Config)

services.name: Amazon CloudWatch
services.oneLinePurpose: Monitoring of metrics, logs, alarms, and dashboards.
keyUseCases: Resource and application health and performance
examPitfalls: Metrics/monitoring ≠ API auditing (CloudTrail)

services.name: AWS Config
services.oneLinePurpose: Tracking of resource configurations and evaluation against rules.
examPitfalls: Resource configuration ≠ API actions (CloudTrail)

services.name: AWS Trusted Advisor
services.oneLinePurpose: Best practice recommendations: cost, security, performance, fault tolerance, and service limits.
examPitfalls: An advisor of best practices; the Health Dashboard reports service events

services.name: AWS CloudFormation
services.oneLinePurpose: Infrastructure as code through templates.
keyUseCases: Provision environments repeatably and in a versioned way
examPitfalls: IaC ≠ console: repeatable, auditable, versioned

services.name: AWS Organizations
services.oneLinePurpose: Centralized management of multiple accounts, with consolidated billing and policies.
examPitfalls: Consolidates billing and governance; it does not unify resource permissions

services.name: AWS Budgets
services.oneLinePurpose: Define budgets and receive alerts when they are exceeded.
keyUseCases: Alerting when spend exceeds a threshold
examPitfalls: Budget alert ≠ historical analysis (Cost Explorer)

services.name: AWS Cost Explorer
services.oneLinePurpose: Visualize, analyze, and forecast spend patterns.
examPitfalls: Analysis/forecast ≠ budget with alerts (Budgets)

services.name: AWS Pricing Calculator
services.oneLinePurpose: Estimate the cost of architectures before implementing them.
examPitfalls: Prior estimation ≠ tracking real spend

services.name: Amazon SNS
services.oneLinePurpose: Publish/subscribe messaging (push) to multiple subscribers.
examPitfalls: SNS pushes to many; SQS queues for consumption

services.name: Amazon SQS
services.oneLinePurpose: Managed message queues to decouple components.
examPitfalls: Queue (pull) ≠ pub/sub (push)

services.name: Amazon Connect
services.oneLinePurpose: Cloud contact center (call center).
keyUseCases: Customer service with IVR and agents
examPitfalls: Contact center ≠ transactional email (SES)

services.name: Amazon SES
services.oneLinePurpose: Sending and receiving email at scale.
examPitfalls: Email ≠ general notifications (SNS)

services.name: AWS Amplify
services.oneLinePurpose: Toolset to develop and deploy web and mobile applications.
examPitfalls: It is a suite, not a single service

services.name: Amazon Athena
services.oneLinePurpose: Query data in S3 with standard SQL, serverless.
keyUseCases: Ad-hoc analysis of data in S3
examPitfalls: Serverless query ≠ data warehouse (Redshift)

services.name: Amazon Kinesis
services.oneLinePurpose: Real-time streaming data ingestion and processing.
examPitfalls: Continuous streaming ≠ point-in-time queue (SQS)

services.name: Amazon QuickSight
services.oneLinePurpose: Business intelligence service with dashboards.
examPitfalls: Visualizes; it does not ingest or transform data

services.name: AWS Glue
services.oneLinePurpose: Serverless data preparation, cataloging, and transformation (ETL).
examPitfalls: ETL ≠ query (Athena) ≠ visualization (QuickSight)

services.name: Amazon SageMaker AI
services.oneLinePurpose: Platform to build, train, and deploy ML models.
examPitfalls: ML platform ≠ ready-to-use ML services (Lex, Polly…)

services.name: Amazon Lex
services.oneLinePurpose: Create chatbots and voice/text conversation assistants.
examPitfalls: Chatbots ≠ contact center (Connect), though they integrate

services.name: AWS Systems Manager
services.oneLinePurpose: Operate and administer fleets: patching, sessions, automation.
examPitfalls: Parameter Store stores parameters and basic secrets

services.name: AWS Elastic Beanstalk
services.oneLinePurpose: Web application deployment managing the infrastructure automatically.
keyUseCases: Upload code, AWS provisions the rest
examPitfalls: Orchestrates EC2 + load balancing + scaling automatically

services.name: AWS Outposts
services.oneLinePurpose: AWS hardware installed at the customer's premises (hybrid cloud).
keyUseCases: Low local latency, partial data residency
examPitfalls: The hybrid model par excellence

services.name: AWS Compute Optimizer
services.oneLinePurpose: Recommends optimal resource sizes with ML (rightsizing).
examPitfalls: Recommended rightsizing ≠ automatic scaling

services.name: AWS Health Dashboard
services.oneLinePurpose: Reports AWS service events and availability affecting your account.
keyUseCases: Knowing whether a problem is AWS's or yours
examPitfalls: Service events ≠ recommendations (Trusted Advisor)

services.name: AWS Migration Hub
services.oneLinePurpose: Central view of migration progress.
examPitfalls: Centralizes tracking; it does not migrate by itself

services.name: AWS Application Discovery Service
services.oneLinePurpose: Discovers on-premises inventory and dependencies before migrating.
examPitfalls: Discovery phase, prior to migrating

services.name: AWS Application Migration Service (MGN)
services.oneLinePurpose: Automates server lift-and-shift (rehost) migrations.
examPitfalls: Automated rehost ≠ platform change

services.name: Amazon API Gateway
services.oneLinePurpose: Create, publish, and secure APIs at scale.
examPitfalls: Exposes APIs; it is not a classic load balancer

services.name: AWS Step Functions
services.oneLinePurpose: Orchestrate visual workflows between services.
examPitfalls: Orchestration ≠ messaging (SQS/SNS/EventBridge)

services.name: Amazon EventBridge
services.oneLinePurpose: Event bus with rule-based routing between services and applications.
examPitfalls: Events routed by rules ≠ queues or simple notifications

services.name: AWS CodePipeline
services.oneLinePurpose: Automate continuous delivery pipelines (CI/CD).
examPitfalls: Orchestrates the pipeline; CodeBuild compiles

services.name: AWS CodeBuild
services.oneLinePurpose: Compile and test code without managing build servers.
examPitfalls: Compiles; it does not deploy by itself

services.name: AWS X-Ray
services.oneLinePurpose: Analyze and debug distributed applications through traces.
examPitfalls: Request traces ≠ infrastructure metrics (CloudWatch)

services.name: Amazon WorkSpaces
services.oneLinePurpose: Managed virtual desktops (VDI).
examPitfalls: Full desktop ≠ apps only (AppStream)

services.name: Amazon AppStream 2.0
services.oneLinePurpose: Stream desktop applications from the cloud to the browser.
examPitfalls: Streamed applications ≠ full desktop (WorkSpaces)

services.name: AWS IoT Core
services.oneLinePurpose: Securely connect and manage IoT devices at scale.
examPitfalls: Devices ≠ web applications (Amplify)

services.name: Amazon Q
services.oneLinePurpose: Generative AI assistant for work, development, and business data.
examPitfalls: Recognize the general purpose; do not go deeper

services.name: Amazon Redshift
services.oneLinePurpose: Data warehouse for large-scale analytics.
examPitfalls: Data warehouse ≠ serverless S3 query (Athena)

services.name: AWS Batch
services.oneLinePurpose: Run batch jobs at any scale.
examPitfalls: Batch administers the queue and compute provisioning

services.name: Amazon Lightsail
services.oneLinePurpose: Simplified cloud with predictable pricing for small projects.
examPitfalls: Simplified ≠ EC2's granular control

services.name: AWS Control Tower
services.oneLinePurpose: Set up and govern a secure, compliant multi-account environment.
examPitfalls: Governs accounts (on top of Organizations); it does not configure individual services

services.name: AWS License Manager
services.oneLinePurpose: Manage and control software licenses in AWS.
examPitfalls: Related to BYOL (D1)

services.name: Amazon Macie
services.oneLinePurpose: Discovers and alerts on personal and sensitive data stored in Amazon S3.
examPitfalls: Sensitive data in S3 ≠ threats (GuardDuty) ≠ vulnerabilities (Inspector)

services.name: AWS Support
services.oneLinePurpose: Technical support plans: Developer, Business, Enterprise On-Ramp, and Enterprise.
examPitfalls: Business = minimum with 24/7 support for production

services.name: AWS Marketplace
services.oneLinePurpose: Catalog of third-party software (ISVs) that runs on AWS.
keyUseCases: Buying software with unified AWS billing
examPitfalls: Third-party software; includes security tools

services.name: AWS CLI
services.oneLinePurpose: Command-line tool to administer AWS services in a scriptable way.
examPitfalls: CLI = repeatable/scriptable; console = manual and visual
